title: Evaluating AI agents for marketing campaign automation | Hightouch

facts.fact: McKinsey research, as cited by Hightouch, says agentic AI could potentially automate 60% of all marketing tasks.
facts.quote: agentic AI could potentially automate 60% of all marketing tasks.

facts.fact: Hightouch cites Stanford's accuracy benchmarks, which tested 26 top-tier frontier models, and reports their hallucination rates ranged from 22% to 94%.
facts.quote: hallucination rates range wildly from 22% to 94%.

facts.fact: Hightouch states that a baseline failure rate of at least 22% for ungoverned AI agents is disastrous for brand campaigns.
facts.quote: A baseline failure rate of 22% (at minimum) for ungoverned AI agents is disastrous for brand campaigns.

facts.fact: The page presents five evaluation criteria for vetting AI agent marketing platforms before signing a contract.
facts.quote: Use these five evaluation criteria to guide your next vendor conversation rather than relying on them for a post-purchase audit.

facts.fact: The page states that AI agents for marketing campaign automation require two critical foundations: governed customer data and operational brand knowledge.
facts.quote: Agents require two critical foundations: governed customer data via a Composable CDP and operational brand knowledge.
